title: Kosovo war begins
description: The Kosovo Liberation Army fights for independence from Serbia (1998–99); crimes from this period are later tried in The Hague.

title: Thaçi sentenced to 25 years
description: The Kosovo Specialist Chambers convicts former president Hashim Thaçi on four counts of war crimes.

title: Busan trade truce with China
description: The US suspends tariffs in exchange for Chinese rare-earth and critical-mineral exports.

title: Fed raises rates to 3.75–4%
description: The FOMC raises the federal funds target range by 0.25 percentage points.

title: Busan trade truce with the US
description: China agrees to rare-earth and critical-mineral exports in exchange for a pause on US tariffs.

title: India FTA signed in New Delhi
description: New Zealand and India sign their free trade agreement.

title: New Zealand FTA signed
description: India and New Zealand sign their free trade agreement in New Delhi.

title: Ebola passes 6,700 confirmed cases
description: WHO reports 6,757 confirmed cases and 3,267 deaths across 61 health zones in six provinces.

title: State Duma elections open
description: Three days of voting (18–20 September), including in occupied parts of Ukraine.

title: Houthis take the Hanish islands
description: Greater and Lesser Hanish fall to Houthi forces near the Bab el-Mandeb Strait.
